field_scope: The all-size symmetric-power rank formula imports a complex boundary-format determinant theorem. The actual degeneration theorem is stated over C. Positive real theta of sum one parameterizes the formal potential.
attribution: DO01 provides a primary proof of the boundary-format determinant theorem of Gelfand, Kapranov and Zelevinsky. AVZ26 provides the formal potential, concavity and endpoint bound. The finite curvature/rank representation, heterogeneous dimension dual, and balancing application are owner-directed Codex deductions. No historical priority or independent mathematical review is claimed.

sources.title: The Binet-Cauchy Theorem for the Hyperdeterminant of boundary format multidimensional Matrices

sources.hypotheses: Complex spaces dim V_i=k_i+1; boundary format k_0=sum_{i>0}k_i. Nondegenerate means the associated map on nonzero decomposable vectors has no zero. The natural critical map has nonzero determinant exactly in that case.
sources.local_instantiation: V_0=C, V_1=B, V_2=A; k_0=a+b-2, k_1=b-1, k_2=a-1; m_1=0, m_2=b-1. Polynomial multiplication is nondegenerate. Cases a=1 or b=1 are proved directly.
